title: alectra alectroides
intro: Alectra alectroides, commonly known as Alectra, is a plant species belonging to the Orobanchaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Alectra include its use in treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
